title: Almost impossible to clean
text: Almost impossible to clean. Truly difficult to clean.  Followed washing instruction, tried 4 times, still won't dark spots out.  Brought it outside and used scrub brush and high pressure wash on it.  WAY TOO much effort to make it slightly cleaner. Wouldn't buy again
